{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script> -- <TASK_ID>

# Slurm resources:
#   --mem-per-cpu=6G

#flux: -n 1
#flux: -c 1

# Omitted Slurm option: --mem-per-cpu=6G
# Flux memory requests are site/config dependent and not universally portable.
# Performance implication: job may be scheduled on nodes with insufficient memory, risking OOM kills or degraded performance.

# SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID is not set under Flux. Accept task id as first argument.
TASK_ID=${1:-0}

matlab -nodisplay '+single_thread+' '+jvm_string+' -nodesktop -r "addpath('../scripts/matlab/'); run_selective_search(${TASK_ID});"
"
}
